_comment: Greenvale village prop kit for the vertical slice (brief sections 69 and 90).
Subjects only. Art direction lives in Tools/hollowasset/style.py so the whole
kit can be restyled from one place. Region sets the texture palette.
Regenerate a single entry with: generate <this file> --id <asset id>

assets.subject: wooden barrel with three iron bands, slightly tapered staves
square wooden shipping crate with plank seams and corner braces
simple wooden village chair with a woven rush seat
round clay storage urn with a painted band around the shoulder
hanging wooden inn sign on an iron bracket, blank painted board
three-rail wooden fence section, one module wide, flush ends for tiling
assets.extra: modular kit piece, ends flat and aligned to a one metre grid

assets.subject: round stone village well with a wooden winch frame and bucket
market stall with a striped cloth awning and a plank counter
broad oak tree with a rounded canopy in three angular masses
narrower younger oak tree, leaning slightly, two canopy masses
weathered granite boulder with flat angular faces and moss on top
